title: F3 SD Card Health Check Weekly Scan Time Trend
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f3:card scan_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(scan_minutes) as avg_duration, max(scan_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst scan time for F3 SD card health check events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture scan_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average scan time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether F3 SD card health check tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
